summary: Review flashcards anywhere, even without Wi-Fi.
page_description: Study with large reveal and answer controls designed for a Kobo screen.
release_notes: First launch without a collection now offers a built-in sample deck or walks you through staging one from your computer. Review settings explain how grades are kept in the local review log.

steps.text: Turn an Anki deck into a collection on this computer.
Plug the Kobo in over USB and stage the collection on it.
Or start with the sample deck from the app, no computer needed.
